# Self-hosted OpenCV.js

Downloaded from https://docs.opencv.org/4.x/opencv.js on 2026-10-25.
This is a pinned local copy of the upstream rolling build, with embedded WebAssembly.
SHA-256: `63366510248adf3a7eddf3e793dd825404efb7df3749f4d6f8557c7fa4ca8aa0`.
License: see OpenCV-LICENSE.txt (upstream https://github.com/opencv/opencv/blob/4.x/LICENSE).

组件由本站提供，手机不再依赖 docs.opencv.org。首次加载约 11 MB；慢网络超过 30 秒会提示等待，但不会停止就绪检测。
